top_signals.title: Container Shipping Companies Navigate Route Challenges
top_signals.summary: Lee Klaskow, Senior Logistics Analyst at Bloomberg Intelligence, discussed how container shipping companies are managing disruptions caused by route restrictions and geopolitical tensions. Despite only about a third of typical Suez Canal routes currently in use, companies remain confident that full utilization will resume over time, with alternative routes around Africa available if needed.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: UK Economy Remains Resilient Despite Iran War and Higher Energy Prices
top_signals.summary: The UK economy grew 0.4 per cent between April and June, official data has revealed, in a sign that businesses and consumers have so far weathered the worst shocks of the war in Iran. The growth figure from the Office for National Statistics was in line with analysts’ expectations but came alongside a surprise boost of 0.3 per cent in June, ahead of forecasts. Figures for May were revised down from 0.1 per cent growth to no growth. City economists polled by Bloomberg had predicted that growth in the second quarter would be 0.4 per cent while…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: New Mirai variant adds stealth capabilities to notorious botnet code
top_signals.summary: Beyond Mirai’s usual functions, the new code features include encrypted communications with command-and-control servers and a “sniffer” that looks for default access credentials.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: Voi rides on in London borough despite council order
top_signals.summary: Voi is continuing to operate hundreds of e-bikes in Ealing despite the council choosing Lime and Forest to run its new rental scheme, City AM understands.
